parts.label: (iii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Area under curve $=\left[\frac12(4x+1)^{3/2}-x^2\right]_0^2$. — M1. Guidance: Uses their integral and their “2” and 0 correctly. $(13.5-4)-0.5$ or $9.5-0.5=9$. — A1. Guidance: No working implies use of integration function on calculator M0A0. Area under chord $=$ trapezium $=\frac12\times2\times(3+5)=8$, or $\left[\frac{x^2}{2}+3x\right]_0^2=8$. — M1. Guidance: Either using the area of a trapezium with their 2, 3 and 5, or $\int(\text{their }x+3)\,\mathrm dx$ using their 2 and 0 correctly. Shaded area $=9-8=1$. — A1. Guidance: Dependent on both method marks. OR area between chord and curve: $\int_0^2[3\sqrt{4x+1}-2x-(x+3)]\,\mathrm dx=\int_0^2[3\sqrt{4x+1}-3x-3]\,\mathrm dx$. — M1. Guidance: Subtracts their line from given curve and uses their 2 and 0 correctly. $=3\left[\frac16(4x+1)^{3/2}-\frac{x^2}{2}-x\right]_0^2$. — A1. Guidance: All integration correct and limits 2 and 0. $=3\{(\frac{27}{6}-2-2)-(\frac16)\}$. — M1. Guidance: Evidence of substituting their 2 and 0 into their integral. $=3\{\frac12-\frac16\}=3\{\frac13\}=1$. — A1. Guidance: No working implies use of a calculator M0A0. Total 4.
